# Supplied legacy CoolProp dependency

The ZIP preserves all files from the supplied `2.CoolProp Properties` directory. Extract into `third_party/coolprop_legacy/`; it contains `cool/` and `test.m`.

Its `.mexw64` binary targets Windows 64-bit. Compatibility was not tested. Compression keeps the browser upload below GitHub's 100-file batch limit; avoid uploading the extracted hundreds of wrapper files unintentionally.

CoolProp retains its own license. No license text was present in this source folder. See https://github.com/CoolProp/CoolProp and https://coolprop.org/coolprop/wrappers/MATLAB/index.html for upstream licensing and interface documentation.
